_readme: All lengths in mm. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Run: python generate.py [other_params.json]

measured._note: Original hand measurements. Diagram letters (printed by generate.py): A housing width, B insert height, C insert width, D insert depth, E hole from top, F hole diameter, G housing curve width, H housing curve depth, I bottom depth, J top button width, K top button height, L middle height, M bottom height.
measured._HOLE_FROM_TOP: Distance from the top of the insert down to the hole centre
measured._HOUSING_CURVE_WIDTH: Chord width of the housing curve
measured._BOTTOM_DEPTH: Front-to-back depth of the bottom section; null follows INSERT_DEPTH
measured._NECK_DEPTH: Front-to-back thickness of the middle section (not in the diagram)
measured._HEIGHT_MODE: 'overall': INSERT_HEIGHT is the height and the middle height is INSERT_HEIGHT - TOP_BUTTON_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_HEIGHT. 'sections': the three section heights are used literally and the height is their sum.

fit._note: Tweak the printed part without touching the measured dimensions.
fit._HOLE_X_OFFSET: Sideways shift of the hole from the centre line (+X = right, looking at the front)
fit._APPLY_HOUSING_CURVE: Curve the back face to match the housing

tube._note: Cylinder that fills the hole (concentric) and stands out of the back face. Outer diameter = HOLE_DIAMETER, bore = HOLE_DIAMETER - 2 * TUBE_WALL.
tube._TUBE_LENGTH: How far the tube stands out past the back face

curve._note: Housing curve radius = (W^2 + 4*H^2) / (8*H), with W = HOUSING_CURVE_WIDTH and H = HOUSING_CURVE_DEPTH, when CALCULATE_CURVE_FROM_HOUSING is true; otherwise MANUAL_CURVE_RADIUS.

output._note: Point these somewhere else in a copy of this file to keep several variants side by side.
